package consumer

import (
	"context"

	"github.com/progresshans/godj/conformance/relationfixture/authors"
	"github.com/progresshans/godj/conformance/relationfixture/project"
	"github.com/progresshans/godj/db"
)

func consume(
	ctx context.Context,
	backend db.Queryer,
	owners []authors.Author,
) ([]*project.AuthorsAuthorReverseObject, error) {
	prefetches, err := project.BindReversePrefetches()
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	return prefetches.AuthorsAuthor.Posts(ctx, backend, owners)
}
